items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 159:1
items.html: The Malchut of the head, in which the screen was corrected for a coupling of striking with the upper light, is called the coupling Malchut. And she raises the reflected light according to the measure of the coarseness in the corrected screen in her, and clothes the ten Sefirot of direct light from below upward. And afterwards she expands from within her with her reflected light from above downward, and brings out the ten Sefirot of the body, until she reaches her concluding Malchut, in which the degree is cut off. (Part 1, Page 888, Sub Header, "and he raised").
